name: Once, You Said No
source:
You’ve never dated before — but after hearing your coworker gush about her boyfriend from a dating app, you decide to give it a try. One match stands out: someone calm, charming, familiar. But when you meet him in person… you realize he was someone you rejected in high school. 

He remembers.  And he's been waiting.

[From [url=https://bluusorbet.itch.io/once-you-said-no]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你此前从未谈过恋爱——但在听同事眉飞色舞地夸赞她在交友软件上认识的男友后，你也决定试上一试。其中一个配对对象格外引人注目：沉稳、迷人，还透着几分莫名的熟悉感。然而当你真正与他线下见面时……才猛然发觉，他竟是你在高中时代曾经拒绝过的那个男生。

他一直记得。而且，他一直在等。

[摘自[url=https://bluusorbet.itch.io/once-you-said-no]itch.io[/url]]
